cost_per_audio_hour.source: vendor public list pricing, cited per system

aggregation.corpus_metric_formula: sum(errors) / sum(reference_units) across all utterances in a (system, condition) pair
aggregation.cross_condition_pooling: never — conditions reported side by side only

inclusion_exclusion.include_if: ground truth traces to a cited source or documented synthetic transform of a cited source AND audio file hash matches dataset_manifest.jsonl AND the system returned a non-error response
inclusion_exclusion.exclude_from_aggregate_if: system call failed (timeout/HTTP error/empty response/rate limit) — logged to results/raw/<system>/failures.json, never scored as 0% or 100%
inclusion_exclusion.not_evaluated_if: system was never run against a condition (e.g. no credentials) — reported as not_evaluated, never as a number

videotext_production.status_at_freeze: runner implemented, not executed (no API key available)

openai_whisper_api.status_at_freeze: runner implemented, not executed (no API key available)

deepgram.status_at_freeze: runner implemented, not executed (no API key available)

timing_methodology: wall_clock; vendor completed_at - created_at for async APIs, request-to-response for synchronous calls; RTF = audio_duration_sec / processing_sec
